transcript: Good morning. This is Sarah from accounting. Could you please send me the expense reports for March by Friday afternoon?
prompt: What does the speaker want?
explanation: Sarah asks for the expense reports for March by Friday afternoon.

transcript: Attention passengers. Flight 482 to Tokyo has been delayed by forty-five minutes due to weather conditions. Please remain in the gate area.
prompt: Why is the flight delayed?
explanation: The announcement states the delay is due to weather conditions.

transcript: I'd like a table for four near the window, please. We have a reservation under the name Chen for seven o'clock.
prompt: What is the speaker requesting?
explanation: The speaker wants a table for four near the window under the name Chen.

transcript: Let's postpone the product launch meeting until next Tuesday. Mark is still preparing the sales projections.
prompt: What will happen to the meeting?
choices: It will be moved to next Tuesday
explanation: The speaker suggests postponing until next Tuesday.

transcript: Hi Tom, I just forwarded you the draft contract. Please review the payment terms and reply with any comments before noon.
prompt: What should Tom do?
explanation: Tom should review the payment terms and reply with comments before noon.

transcript: The printer on the third floor is out of toner. I've ordered a replacement cartridge, but it won't arrive until Thursday.
prompt: When will the toner arrive?
explanation: The speaker says the replacement will arrive on Thursday.

transcript: Your hotel room includes breakfast and free Wi-Fi. Checkout is at eleven, and the airport shuttle leaves every thirty minutes.
prompt: What is included with the room?
explanation: Breakfast and free Wi-Fi are included.

transcript: I'm sorry, but we're all out of the grilled salmon today. May I recommend the roasted chicken instead? It comes with seasonal vegetables.
prompt: Why can't the customer order salmon?
choices: It is not on the menu
They have run out of it
The chef refuses to cook it
explanation: The server says they are all out of the grilled salmon.

transcript: Before we begin, please silence your phones. We'll start with the quarterly figures and then open the floor for questions.
prompt: What will happen first in the meeting?
explanation: They will start with the quarterly figures.

transcript: Could you cover my shift on Saturday? I have a family wedding to attend, and I'll return the favor whenever you need.
prompt: Why does the speaker need coverage?
explanation: The speaker has a family wedding on Saturday.

transcript: Please have your boarding pass and passport ready. Gate B12 closes in fifteen minutes, and we will not wait for late passengers.
prompt: What must passengers prepare?
explanation: Passengers need boarding pass and passport ready.

transcript: Thanks for your application. We'd like to invite you for a second interview next Wednesday at two p.m. Please confirm your availability.
prompt: What is the listener being invited to?
explanation: The speaker invites them for a second interview.

transcript: The lunch special today is a club sandwich with fries for eight dollars. Soft drinks are two dollars extra.
prompt: How much is the lunch special?
explanation: The club sandwich with fries is eight dollars.

transcript: IT will be upgrading the company servers this weekend. Please save all your work by Friday evening and expect limited email access on Saturday.
prompt: What should employees do by Friday evening?
explanation: Employees should save all work by Friday evening.

transcript: I'd like everyone to prepare a five-minute update on their project status. We'll go around the table starting with the marketing team.
prompt: What should each person prepare?
explanation: Each person should prepare a five-minute project status update.

transcript: There is heavy traffic on Highway 5. If you're heading to the convention center, take Exit 12 and follow the detour signs.
prompt: What is the recommended action?
choices: Take Exit 12 and follow detour signs
explanation: Listeners heading to the convention center should take Exit 12.

transcript: The new employee handbook is available on the intranet. Please read the updated leave policy and acknowledge it by the end of the month.
prompt: What must employees do by month-end?
explanation: They must read and acknowledge the updated leave policy.

transcript: Would you like your coffee with milk or sugar? We also have oat milk and almond milk if you prefer a non-dairy option.
prompt: What alternatives does the server offer?
explanation: Non-dairy options include oat milk and almond milk.

transcript: I've attached the revised proposal. The budget has been reduced by ten percent, and the timeline has been extended by two weeks.
prompt: How has the proposal changed?
explanation: Budget reduced 10% and timeline extended by two weeks.

transcript: Unfortunately, the conference room is booked until three. Let's meet in the lobby cafe instead, and I'll bring the presentation slides on my laptop.
prompt: Where will they meet?
explanation: They will meet in the lobby cafe because the conference room is booked.

transcript: Your rental car is a compact sedan. It's parked in Space 47 on Level B. Return it with a full tank to avoid extra charges.
prompt: What should the customer do when returning the car?
choices: Return it with a full tank
explanation: Return with a full tank to avoid extra charges.

transcript: We're hiring two junior analysts for the finance team. The posting closes next Monday, so please share it with qualified candidates.
prompt: When does the job posting close?
explanation: The posting closes next Monday.

transcript: Our kitchen closes at nine thirty, but the bar stays open until midnight. Last orders for food should be placed by nine fifteen.
prompt: When should last food orders be placed?
explanation: Last food orders by 9:15; kitchen closes at 9:30.

transcript: After reviewing the customer feedback, I recommend we redesign the packaging. Sales dropped twelve percent after the last redesign failed.
prompt: What does the speaker recommend?
explanation: The speaker recommends redesigning the packaging.

transcript: Please CC me on all correspondence with the supplier. I want to stay informed about delivery schedules and invoice disputes.
prompt: Why does the speaker want to be CC'd?
choices: To stay informed about deliveries and disputes
explanation: They want to stay informed about delivery schedules and invoice disputes.

transcript: The museum opens at ten and free admission is available every first Sunday. Guided tours start on the hour and last about forty minutes.
prompt: When is free admission available?
explanation: Free admission is on every first Sunday.

transcript: Don't forget that daylight saving time begins this weekend. Set your clocks forward one hour, or you might miss Monday's morning standup.
prompt: What should people do this weekend?
explanation: Clocks should be set forward one hour.

transcript: This dish contains peanuts and shellfish. Please let your server know if you have any food allergies before ordering.
prompt: What should customers with allergies do?
explanation: They should tell the server about allergies before ordering.

transcript: We'll wrap up in five minutes. Please submit your action items to the shared folder by tomorrow morning so we can track progress.
prompt: When are action items due?
explanation: Action items should be submitted by tomorrow morning.

transcript: The air conditioning in Building C is being repaired. Until further notice, employees there may work remotely or use desks in Building A.
prompt: What options do Building C employees have?
choices: Work remotely or use Building A desks
explanation: They may work remotely or use desks in Building A.
